title: Expenses component data
description: Shared expenses. Each expense is an e_<uuid> key, each settlement an s_<uuid> key and each reminder an r_<creditor>__<debtor> key; the value is a JSON-encoded string of $defs/expense, $defs/settlement or $defs/reminder, and '' deletes it (tombstone). Amounts are integer minor units (cents). Any member may add, edit or delete expenses. A settlement records that from paid to; either party (from or to) may record, edit or delete it, so one of them must be your own public key. A reminder nudges a debtor: r_<creditor>__<debtor> with from the creditor and to the debtor, written only by the creditor (from). Each member may publish how they want to be paid in their own pay_<publicKey> key. The entry v is optional: write none, the app stamps it.

v.description: Wire format version, written by the app. Absent means 1.

_title.description: The card title shown in this component's card header. Blank shows the component type name.

_sectionBreak.description: true starts a new card. Set it true on any component that should stand alone: when absent, a component directly after a group (a component with _sectionTitle) joins that group.

_sectionTitle.description: Names a group of 2 or more cards shown inside one frame. Set only on the group's first component; the components after it without _sectionBreak true are its members. '' clears it. Example: "Flight to Lisbon".

_width.description: Preferred width in logical pixels. Default 600, minimum 300.

_spaceAbove.description: Legacy spacing above in pixels, no longer written. When _sectionBreak is absent, a value of 16 or more reads as a section break.

_spaceBelow.description: Legacy spacing below in pixels, no longer written.

^e_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[.description: One expense, a JSON-encoded string of $defs/expense. Key e_<uuid>. '' deletes it. Any member may add, edit or delete. Write no v. Include with (the members who share it) to split between some members only; without it the expense is split between all current members. Example value: "{\"what\":\"Dinner\",\"payer\":\"<publicKey>\",\"amount\":4500}". Annotation only: '' and future non-JSON values are also stored here.

^s_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[.description: One settlement, a JSON-encoded string of $defs/settlement. Key s_<uuid>. '' deletes it. Either party (from or to) may record, edit or delete it, so from or to must be your own public key. Example value: "{\"from\":\"<debtor publicKey>\",\"to\":\"<creditor publicKey>\",\"amount\":2000}". Annotation only: '' and future non-JSON values are also stored here.

^pay_.+$.description: How one member wants to be paid, key pay_<publicKey>, a native JSON array of $defs/payMethod (not a string); '' clears it. You can only write the key ending in your own public key. Example: pay_<yourPublicKey> = [{"id":"m1","type":"blik","value":"600123456"},{"id":"m2","type":"iban","value":"PL61109010140000071219812874","label":"Main account"}].

^r_[^_]+__[^_]+$.description: One payment reminder, a JSON-encoded string of $defs/reminder. Key r_<creditor>__<debtor> with two underscores, both public keys (base64 has no underscore); one reminder per pair, a newer write replaces it. '' deletes it. Only the creditor (from) may write it, so from must be your own public key. Example: r_<creditor>__<debtor> = "{\"from\":\"<creditor publicKey>\",\"to\":\"<debtor publicKey>\",\"amount\":2000,\"at\":1767225600000}". Annotation only: '' and future non-JSON values are also stored here.

^_.description: Other layout and UI keys starting with _. Any value.

v.description: Entry format version. Optional: write none, the app stamps it.

what.description: What the money was spent on. Example: "Dinner".

payer.description: Public key of the member who paid.

amount.description: Amount in integer minor units (cents). Example: 4500 is 45.00.

with.description: Public keys of the members who share the expense. Absent means all current members.

v.description: Entry format version. Optional: write none, the app stamps it.

from.description: Public key of the member who paid back.

to.description: Public key of the member who received the money (the creditor).

amount.description: Amount in integer minor units (cents), at least 1. Example: 2000 is 20.00.

v.description: Entry format version. Optional: write none, the app stamps it.

from.description: Public key of the member who is owed the money (the creditor).

to.description: Public key of the member who owes the money (the debtor).

amount.description: Amount owed in integer minor units (cents), at least 1. Example: 2000 is 20.00.

at.description: When the reminder was sent, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

id.description: Id of this method, unique inside the array. Example: "m1".

value.description: The phone number, IBAN or free text to pay to. Example: "600123456".

label.description: Optional name shown next to the method. Example: "Main account".
